findings.title: Deployment payments/api: Immutable container filesystem (C-0017)
findings.description: Kubescape control C-0017 (Immutable container filesystem) failed for Deployment payments/api in cluster prod-example.
findings.remediation:
Fix: set spec.template.spec.containers[0].securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem to true; set spec.template.spec.containers[1].securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem to true

See https://hub.armosec.io/docs/c-0017
